title: Destinations
lead: Where downloads go. Each destination is a category of your download client, and the category decides the folder.
actionFailed: Could not change this destination. Reload the page and try again.
refreshFailed: Refresh failed, showing the last loaded destinations.
empty: No destinations yet. Click Add destination to pick a category of your download client.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.message: The app forgets the destination {{name}}. Its category stays in {{client}}, and nothing changes in the client. This can't be undone.
remove.messageDefault: The app forgets the destination {{name}}. Its category stays in {{client}}, and nothing changes in the client. {{name}} is the default destination: no destination is the default until you pick another one. This can't be undone.

dialog.createDescription: Pick a category of your download client. The client decides the folder; the app checks with it that the category exists and where it lands.
dialog.editDescription: A new client or category is checked with the client before it is saved.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.clientsFailed: Could not load the download clients.
dialog.noClients: No download client yet. Add one under Integrations first.
dialog.categoriesLoading: Asking the client for its categories…
dialog.categoriesFailed: Could not ask the client for its categories.
dialog.noCategories: {{client}} has no categories. Create one in the client, then open this dialog again.
dialog.categoryMissingHint: {{client}} no longer has this category. Pick another one, or create it in the client again.
dialog.defaultHint: Only one destination is the default: ticking this one takes it from the other. The first destination you add becomes the default on its own.
dialog.sectionsHint: The Download dialog picks this destination for a release listed in a section you tick here, such as Мультсеріали for Cartoons. A section ticked for another destination moves here.
dialog.sectionsLoading: Asking the release sources for their sections…
dialog.sectionsFailed: Could not load the sections of the release sources.
dialog.noSources: No release source yet. Add one under Integrations to pick its sections.
